initialization: fresh; paired exactly within seed, independent between seeds
new_data: Positive affine transforms of common latent/optical arrays; independently sampled midpoint [0.12,0.88] and contrast [0.08,min(0.70,2*(midpoint-0.03),2*(0.97-midpoint))]. Same geometry, optics, temporal schedule and absolute sensor-noise draws. No SEM-derived scale or shrink labels.

evaluation.unchanged_development: same 96 R118 development scenes (192 views), with image and target-relative gradient/high-pass errors by role
evaluation.controlled_geometry_motion: all 240 R119 controlled physical conditions + 100 radiometry conditions, shared inputs, final float outputs, per-profile validity retained
evaluation.real_shape: all 12 exposures x 36 pillars with unchanged historical ACM reference plus separately generated one-factor global pitch-matched reference, no per-pillar shape fitting
evaluation.real_displacement: If an intervention is supported by both seeds on shape, synthetic motion and texture, run full Raw-locked real LSC for the supported arm and matched control before calling it ready for further training.

decision.paired_primary: Both seeds must improve pillar-paired SEM boundary error vs corresponding A on BOTH references; worst exposure median may not regress by >0.01 pitch percentage points vs A.
decision.motion_guard: Worst controlled relative-motion error <= matched A +0.01 px; no increase in invalid profiles.
decision.texture_guard: Mean target-relative high-pass error on fixed textured-edge development views <= matched A *1.02.
decision.absolute_guard: Report comparisons to Raw explicitly; no replacement or long training solely from relative improvement.
decision.if_unsupported: Preserve all results, do not extend epochs or retune weights to force a pass.
